# It depends on the reference point

<!-- STEP id="book" -->
With the classroom as the reference point, the book is at rest. With the Sun as the reference point, the book is in motion, because the Earth moves around the Sun.

<!-- STEP id="bus" -->
A passenger sits in a moving bus. With the bus as the reference point, she is at rest. With the road as the reference point, she is in motion.

**Rest and motion depend on the reference point we choose.**
